A type of '''drone ship''' was purchased by the [[Cestus Cybernetics]] corporation for defensive purposes. One such ship was later used in the attempted assassination of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].
